semantic_order: man-not-ball foul contact -> free-kick award -> served free kick -> 2nd foul contact -> caution (yellow) issued

rendering.surface: src/apps/browser/test-bridge.ts + real Three renderer (Chromium), same createSimulation config surface the shipped composition root uses
rendering.hud: showMatchPhaseHud:true + showCardHud:true (curated FREE KICK label + yellow booking notice, presentation-only enrichment)

frames.label: foul-contact
frames.description: Man-not-ball tackle contact (the first foul): the defending body commits a standing tackle on the carrier — both in contact, the ball still in play (PLAYING) before the free kick is awarded

frames.label: freekick-award
frames.description: Free kick awarded for the first foul: the phase turns FREE KICK, the ball is re-placed at the contact position (team-b awarded)

frames.label: freekick-served
frames.description: Served free kick: the ball is back in play off the contact spot along the committed kick direction, the phase is PLAYING again

frames.label: foul-2-contact
frames.description: The 2nd man-not-ball tackle contact (the offending player's 2nd accumulated foul) — still PLAYING before the booking

frames.label: caution
frames.description: Caution (yellow) issued on the 2nd accumulated foul: the card consequence issues a caution to player-1 (accumulated 2); the card HUD draws the yellow booking and the 2nd free kick is awarded (phase FREE KICK)
